description.p: You have a modded Xbox 360 running the Aurora dashboard and some game backups on your computer. This app copies them onto the console (or onto a USB drive) in the format it understands, without requiring you to know how any of it works.

ul.li: Drop in a game file and it figures out the type and prepares it automatically
ISO to GOD conversion, and extraction of original Xbox titles
Detects plugged-in USB drives and remote consoles, then suggests where games should go
Box art downloaded automatically from XboxUnity
Transfers over the network with FTP, straight to a USB drive, or onto the console's own hard drive plugged into the computer
Title update and DLC management
Native app written in Rust and Slint
